RFA_Doctrine_Seminar.text: Fleet Academy doctrine seminar — compact tiered classroom in the Core arranged around a central tactical-history table rather than a lecturer's podium. Mature Fleet blue, gold and white dominate. Five Crown crests appear as equal-sized engraved emblems in one wall band, differentiated by iconography and material treatment rather than full-field red/green faction colors. Windows look toward active Fleet traffic so doctrine never feels detached from service.

RFA_Crown_Gallery.text: Fleet Academy Crown Gallery — vaulted public passage used by cadets and visitors, with the five Crown crests displayed at equal scale beneath a larger Fleet constellation. Use current Fleet blue/gold/white color grammar. Crown lineage is shown through motifs: archive-ring/guardian forms for Aurelian, beacon geometry for Cerulean, burden/fire-forged metalwork for Ember, storm-line forms for Tempest, paired shield/convoy arcs for Aegis. Do not turn the hall into five unrelated color-coded houses.

RFA_Archive_Theater.text: Fleet Academy archive theater — circular reconstruction room with a low central projection table, surrounding dark glass, physical document drawers, and layered evidentiary displays. Reconstructions should visibly distinguish source layers: hard records, later testimony, and Academy inference. The room can dissolve visually into historical scenes without implying literal time travel.
